name: deuxui
description: UX engineering with a verdict, from the first wireframe to the release gate: a 235-rule interface contract, 184 static checks, a browser tier that forces the offline/empty/failed states nobody tests, 38 iOS and Android rules, wireframes rendered from the declared contract, a generated working prototype a person can click and use, a live A/B review page where they Alt-click an element and say what is wrong in their own words, a phase gate that refuses production UI edits until somebody has accepted a prototype, and a release gate where NOT_RUN never counts as a pass.
